name: Eloise Aetas
source:
[spoiler]Traitor. Is an accomplice of the demons. Plotted against Sariel. Has a price on her head.[/spoiler] Tried to force Karla to marry in her husband's family against her will.

Daughter of Sariel and Godfrey(Deceased). Wife of Simon.

[In game description]
